comment: No source is published. This is the Free cut of the maker's Detour. The panel is titled DETOUR and the module browser calls it Detour Free, while the model slug is Vector-Synth. Parameter ranges: PITCH 0 to 8.5834 with a default at 4.2917, V1 and V2 0 to 4 with a default of 0.5, D1 and D2 declared from 0.5 down to 0 with a default of 0, so those two knobs run backwards, FREQ 0.001 to 1 with a default of 1, RESO 0 to 0.99 with a default of 0.5, decay and sustain defaulting to 1 and attack and release to 0, and every attenuator and envelope amount 0 to 1 with a default of 0. The octave switch gives minus two, minus one and no offset for its three positions, and defaults to minus one. Six parameters, indices 6 to 11, are declared and given no widget and are read nowhere in process; they cannot be clicked and get no line. Four more, indices 26, 32, 33 and 34, are the SLOW R button and the three view buttons: they are never passed to configParam, so they carry Rack's default quantity with no name, but process reads all four and they each toggle a flag and light a lamp. The three view flags reach only Display::drawLayer, which uses them to choose between drawing the parameter, the attenuator, the envelope amount or the mix for the red pair, the blue pair and the filter. The V and D CV jacks, the FM jack and the filter CV jack are all read at channel one only; the pitch and gate jacks are read channel by channel. Five lamps show the voltage on the V, D and filter CV jacks at half scale. The context menu holds only Model 2 (softer sound and V modulation):  and High Quality, both saved in the patch along with the long envelope and linear FM flags.
